Aluxes.personality: Tiny, invisible, mischievous, loyal for seven years
Aluxes.playsLike: Guard the milpa, call the rain, and let the corn grow tall

Rain-Fed.reminder: At the start of each round this unit gets +1 Power and +1 Health, up to +3/+3.

lore.from: Yucatec Maya folklore: Yucatán, Quintana Roo and Campeche (Mexico), Belize and Guatemala
lore.title: The Aluxes
story: At the edge of a cornfield in Yucatán stands a house no bigger than a shoebox, built of stone, with a little palm roof and a dark doorway. Nobody lives in it. That is what you would think.

The Maya farmers know better. When a farmer clears a new field, the healer of the village, the j-meen, shapes a small figure out of clay and prays over it for weeks. Then it is set inside the little house, and an alux comes to live there: a spirit no taller than your knee, dressed like a tiny farmer in white cotton, a straw hat and sandals. You will almost never see him. A shadow between the corn rows, a breeze that comes from nowhere, footprints the size of a bird's: that is all he leaves behind.

For seven years the alux works. He helps the corn grow tall, calls the rain when the ground is dry, and walks the field every night, whistling so loudly that thieves and hungry animals turn and run. All he asks is a little something on his doorstep: a bowl of sweet corn drink, a drop of honey, a few tortillas, a sweet or two.

Forget the offering and he turns to tricks. Your tools vanish. Pots and pans fly across the kitchen. Walk into the jungle and he leads you round in circles until you say please. And when the seven years are over, the farmer must seal the little door, or the alux runs wild for good.

The aluxes are still there today. Hotels keep little houses for them in their gardens, and when a bridge near Cancún fell down three times, the builders made the aluxes a house of their own. The bridge has stood ever since.
facts: An alux is knee-high and looks like a tiny Maya farmer: white cotton clothes, a straw hat and huarache sandals.
A farmer builds a doll-sized stone house, the kahtal alux, at the edge of his cornfield, and an alux comes to live in it.
For seven years the alux helps the corn grow, calls the rain, and walks the field at night, whistling to scare off thieves and animals.
After the seven years the farmer must seal the little house's door, or the alux runs wild and turns to tricks.
The j-meen, the Maya healer, shapes an alux from clay, prays over it for weeks until it comes to life, and sets it in its house or under the oldest tree on the land, often a great ceiba.
Aluxes are usually invisible. People know one is near from a shadow, a gentle breeze, giggles in the dark, or footprints the size of a bird's.
They love offerings: saká (a sweet corn drink), honey, tortillas, fruit and sweets, left in the little house.
Their tricks are small: putting out fires, tossing pots and pans, hiding tools, tossing pebbles at your feet, and leading walkers in circles in the monte, the jungle.
People who met one say he was dressed like a farmer, with a slingshot in his sash and a little dog trotting behind him.
An alux may stop a traveller on the road and ask for a small offering. Give it, and he brings good luck; refuse, and things go wrong.
Aluxes guard cenotes too, the deep pools of fresh water in the Yucatán rock. The toh bird nests in the cenotes' walls.
Aluxes live in old ruins as well, among the fallen stones of the ancient cities.
Don't say their name out loud: it calls them.
In the 1990s a bridge near Cancún fell down three times while it was being built. A Maya healer said the aluxes were angry, so the builders made them a little house, and the bridge stood.
Builders in Yucatán still hold a ceremony for the aluxes before breaking ground, and hotels keep alux houses on their grounds.

cards.name: Aluxito, Keeper of the Milpa
cards.flavor: Knee-high and invisible. Every corn stalk in the field is his.

kitten.name: Aluxito, Keeper of the Milpa
kitten.text:
Exhaust: A unit you control with Rain-Fed gets +1 Rain-Fed.
Awaken: You have 7 or fewer Candles.

bigCat.name: Aluxito, Caller of the Rain
bigCat.text: Exhaust: A unit you control gets +2 Rain-Fed.

cards.name: Saká-Bearing Alux
cards.text: Lure. Hello: A unit you control gets +2 Health this round.
cards.flavor: A gourd of sweet corn drink, carried to whoever needs it most.

cards.name: Night Patrol Alux
cards.flavor: Walks the rows all night. Nothing gets to the corn.

cards.name: Corn-Tending Alux
cards.text: Rain-Fed. Hello: If you control a Guardian, draw a card.
cards.flavor: Tends the field while the farmer sleeps. The corn is taller by morning.

cards.name: Clay Alux, Fresh from the J-meen
cards.flavor: Shaped from clay by the healer. Seven weeks of prayers, and it stands up.

cards.name: Tool-Hiding Alux
cards.flavor: Your machete was right here. Now it isn't.

cards.name: Slingshot Alux
cards.flavor: Dressed like a farmer, with a slingshot in his sash. Coatis know him.

cards.name: Alux of the Old Stones
cards.flavor: Lives in the fallen stones of a ruin. Stone doesn't feel a hit.

cards.name: Alux of the Ceiba Roots
cards.flavor: The healer set his clay figure under the oldest tree. He grew into it.

cards.name: A Whistle in the Dark
cards.text: Ambush. The enemy unit across from this Ambush deals no damage this Clash.
cards.flavor: He walks the field at night and whistles. Thieves and animals turn back.

cards.name: Honey and Tortillas
cards.text: Lucky. A unit you control gets +3 Health this round. Draw a card.
cards.flavor: Left on the little doorstep at dusk. Gone by morning.

cards.name: Pots and Pans Flung
cards.text: Deal 4 damage to an exhausted enemy unit.
cards.flavor: Fall asleep without leaving an offering, and the kitchen lets you know.

cards.name: Kahtal Alux, the Little House
cards.text: Attached unit gets +3 Health and Guardian.
cards.flavor: A doll-sized house at the edge of the field. Whoever lives in it guards the corn for seven years.

cards.name: The Roadside Alux
cards.text: Once per round, when you heal a unit or give it Health, draw a card.
cards.flavor: Stops travellers and asks for a little something. Give it, and luck follows you home.

cards.name: The Alux of the Sacred Cenote
cards.text: Guardian. At the start of each round, your units get +1 Health this round.
cards.flavor: Guards the deep pool where the rain begins.

cards.name: The Bridge Alux of Cancún
cards.flavor: The bridge fell three times. Then they built him a house, and it stood.

cards.name: The Alux's Dog
cards.flavor: Where an alux walks, a little dog trots behind.

cards.name: Toh, the Cenote Bird
cards.flavor: Nests in the walls of the cenote and knows everything that goes on there.

cards.name: A Sweet on the Doorstep
cards.text: Ambush. A unit you control gets +2 Power this round.
cards.flavor: Sweets and fruit in the little house. The alux works twice as hard.

cards.name: Lost in the Monte
cards.flavor: He walks you in circles until you say please.

aluxes.name: Aluxes
aluxes.blurb: Patient guardians of the cornfield. Wall up, heal with the rain, and let the Rain-Fed corn grow tall.
